title: 1988 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: Suppose the estimated \(20\) billion dollar cost to send a person to the planet Mars is shared equally by the \(250\) million people in the U.S. Then each person’s share is

solutions.text:
Each person’s share is \[ \dfrac{20 \times 10^9}{250 \times 10^6} = \dfrac{2 \times 10^{10}}{2.5 \times 10^{8}}. \]

This equals \(0.8 \times 10^{2} = 80.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Write the numbers with powers of ten: \(20\) billion \(= 2 \times 10^{10}\) and \(250\) million \(= 2.5 \times 10^{8}\)
